DatabaseLevel Up VFX · overview for your approval · 5 Nov 2026

Every screenshot below is a real screenshot of the running app on fake demo leads (made-up names, .test emails). No real lead, sheet or password appears anywhere.

What it does, in one minute

  • Your lead bots keep filling Google Sheets. Database reads them every 2 minutes (it never writes into them) and shows: leads today, this week, this month and last month, by country, state, niche and sheet, how many have an email or phone, and quality out of 10.
  • You and one more admin see everything and decide things. Employees only see the sheets and leads you give them, and each one has their own dashboard.
  • Employees can add leads and ask to remove leads. Nothing is removed until an admin approves it in the Approvals folder. Approved leads wait in Trash for 30 days.
  • Runs on your PC first, no monthly cost. Name Database, brand Level Up VFX, the same purple look as your CRM and Outreach apps.

How the workflow runs

Top to bottom: data comes in, people look at it, and removals go through approval.

What you will see (the working app)

Dark by default with a light switch. Left menu in groups: Overview, Leads, Admin. The phone has a slide-in menu.

Screens designed in the preview chat (not yet in the working app)

The design chat built richer screens on mock data. These are the ones I recommend bringing across. Only the top of each tall page is shown.

Your decision: which look to continue with

A. Keep the working app's look recommended

It already runs and is tested. I bring across the extra screens from the preview (Approvals tabs, Reports, Quality, Geography with local time) in the same style.

B. Use the preview's look everywhere

Restyle the working app to match the preview chat's design (slightly different menu, bigger cards). More work, one consistent look.

C. Change something first

Tell me what to change (colours, menu names, which numbers sit on the dashboard) and I will update the screens before anything else is built.

What I need from you after approval

  1. The links of the first two sheets for the pilot (suggested: AU Leads and AU Only) and whether your lead bots are still running.
  2. A Google service account in its own Google Cloud project; you share the sheets with its email as Viewer.
  3. A Gmail app password for the reset-code emails (it goes into the private settings file, never into chat).

Not verified: the build chat's own report of 390 passing tests (I did not re-run them); everything against real Google Sheets (only fake demo sheets so far); the extra screens in the second gallery exist only as a design on mock data.
